records.name: corrected344-exact-r04-r05
argv:
import json
from pathlib import Path
from dataclasses import asdict
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
import pandas as pd
from algobench.artifact_io import ObjectPublication
from algobench.formal_factor_run_schedule import ReceiptStore,SOURCES
from algobench.formal_model328_manifest import load_feature_manifest,source_columns,content_hash
from algobench.formal_model328_sources import source_panel_frame
from algobench.formal_panel import resolve_day_manifest
from compare_formal_window_outputs import CANDIDATE_KEYS
p=ObjectPublication("/home/wangly/hdd-store","sirui-wangly/wangly",native_control_reads=True)
base=Path("/home/wangly/hdd-store/outputs/sirui/published/szse-model328-factor-bank/corrected344-p75-20261024")
manifest=load_feature_manifest(Path.cwd()/"因子/algobench/configs/open5m_corrected_344_scope_v1.json")
day="2026-03-19"
records=[];stores=[];proofs=[];costs=[]
for run in ("r04","r05"):
 root=base/run
 stores.append(ReceiptStore(root,Path("/tmp/wangly-corrected344-p75-20261024")/("compare-"+run),p.read_json(root/"run_identity.json"),manifest,publisher=p))
 oldroot=root/"old256/runs"/day/run
 result=p.read_json(oldroot/"result.json")
 record=result["factor_manifests"][0]
 m=resolve_day_manifest(record,object_publication=p,staging_root="/tmp/wangly-corrected344-p75-20261024/compare-metadata",share_feature_scopes=True)
 proofs.append(dict(exactness=m["stock_day_exactness_evidence"],candidates={k:m[k] for k in CANDIDATE_KEYS if k in m},replacement_ids=m.get("pair_candidate_replacement_order_ids_hash")))
 costs.append(dict(run=run,runner=result["runner_phase_seconds"],timing=m["timing_seconds"],phases={k:v for k,v in m.items() if k in ("stock_day_phase_seconds","scorer_phase_seconds","derived_day_bucket_commit")}))
 records.append(p.read_json(oldroot/"FACTOR_BANK_RESULT.json")["factor_files"][0])
 del m
assert proofs[0]==proofs[1],"shared/candidate scientific exactness differs"
compared=[]
for source in SOURCES:
 frames=[]
 for index,store in enumerate(stores):
  artifact=records[index] if source=="old" else next(a for a in store.load(day,source)["artifacts"] if a["role"]=="panel")
  frames.append(source_panel_frame(store,artifact))
 columns=["date","code",*source_columns(manifest,source)]
 pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(frames[0][columns],frames[1][columns],check_exact=True)
 compared.append(dict(source=source,rows=len(frames[0]),columns=len(columns)-2))
out=dict(schema_version="corrected344-real-day-exactness-v1",runs=["r04","r05"],date=day,passed=True,values_exact=True,nan_positions_exact=True,sources=compared,scientific_evidence_sha256=content_hash(proofs[0]),costs=costs)
Path("/home/wangly/.local/state/sirui/corrected344-p75-20261024/exact-r04-r05.json").write_text(json.dumps(out))
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in out.items() if k!="costs"}))

import json,hashlib,stat
from pathlib import Path
from algobench.artifact_io import ObjectPublication
from algobench.formal_day_buckets import formal_day_bucket_root
from cleanup_wangly_s3 import Objects,write_json,allowed_target
p=ObjectPublication("/home/wangly/hdd-store","sirui-wangly/wangly",native_control_reads=True);o=Objects()
control=Path("/home/wangly/.local/state/sirui/corrected344-p75-20261024")
proof_path=control/"exact-r04-r05.json";proof=json.loads(proof_path.read_text())
assert proof["passed"] and sum(r["columns"] for r in proof["sources"])==344
raw=Path("/home/wangly/hdd-store/outputs/sirui/published/szse-model328-factor-bank/corrected344-p75-20261024/r03/old256/runs/2026-03-19/r03")
bucket=formal_day_bucket_root(raw,"2026-03-19",window_token="win_0930_0935")
m=p.read_json(bucket/"manifest.json")
generation=bucket/"generations"/m["generation_id"]
prefix=str(generation).removeprefix("/home/wangly/hdd-store/")+"/"
entries=[]
for row in m["components"]:
 path=generation/row["relative_path"]
 name=str(path).removeprefix("/home/wangly/hdd-store/")
 identity=o.head(name)
 assert identity["bytes"]==row["byte_size"] and identity["uid"]=="1007" and stat.S_ISREG(int(identity["mode"]))
 entries.append(dict(target=identity,sha256=m["metadata"]["component_file_sha256"][row["name"]],classification="obsolete",reason="本次已失败且被替代的P75试算订单中间组件；保留全部面板、清单、guard与原始失败记录",proof=dict(failed_guard_sha256="fdccf97e0b5da42b612b947ea23e58eca348a0ad45d8c7905cc901d52a3f54ab",replacement_runs=proof["runs"],comparison_file=str(proof_path),comparison_sha256=hashlib.sha256(proof_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),scientific_evidence_sha256=proof["scientific_evidence_sha256"])))
plan=dict(schema="wangly-s3-cleanup-v1",bucket="wangly",allowed_prefixes=[prefix],entries=entries,max_delete_bytes=sum(r["target"]["bytes"] for r in entries))
for row in entries:allowed_target(row,plan)
out=control/"cleanup-r03-order-components-plan.json";assert not out.exists()
write_json(out,plan)
print(json.dumps(dict(plan=str(out),sha256=hashlib.sha256(out.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),objects=len(entries),bytes=plan["max_delete_bytes"],prefix=prefix)))
